pregunta: ¿Cuáles son los 5 artistas que más han vendido?
sql_referencia: SELECT a.Name, ROUND(SUM(i.Quantity * i.UnitPrice), 2) AS total FROM Artist a JOIN Album al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine i ON t.TrackId = i.TrackId GROUP BY a.ArtistId ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5
